steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Tho Tich, an earth element lizard, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: tongue flicking at the food; (3) EAT: lunging tongue snatch; (4) EAT: chewing with a grin. Row 2: (5) EAT: licking its own eyeball; (6) PLAY: crouching very low; (7) PLAY: a quick dash; (8) PLAY: leaping high. Row 3: (9) PLAY: tail spin in mid-air; (10) PLAY: landing on all fours; (11) PLAY: head frill raised, cheering; (12) REFUSE food: head turned away, tail up. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, belly up; (14) WAVE hello: waving a little claw; (15) SAD: flat on the ground, chin down; (16) ANGRY: frill spread wide, hissing.
